name: glass-panel
title: Glass Panel
description: A broad ray-marched optical slab that carries your own content across a full panel.

name: glass-tile
title: Glass Tile
description: A wall of glass bricks where one shared biconvex lens travels to the hovered tile and bulges through it.

name: chromatic-text
title: Chromatic Text
description: The pointer is the prism: nearby letters split into red and blue fringes over a sliding rainbow.

name: ripple-text
title: Ripple Text
description: Clicks and taps drop ripples that travel outward through your words; a resting pointer leaves a dimple.

name: spectrum-text
title: Spectrum Text
description: A spectral light band flows continuously through your words and leans toward the pointer.

name: tilt-card
title: Tilt Card
description: A porcelain card that tilts in space while its specular highlight tracks the pointer across the surface.

name: pointer-glow
title: Pointer Glow
description: A handheld light for layouts: the room dims slightly and a warm source follows your pointer over your own content.

name: spotlight-card
title: Spotlight Card
description: A card under a torch: the beam follows the pointer to uncover your content from the dark.

name: elastic-hover
title: Elastic Hover
description: Rubber around anything you wrap: hover swells, press squashes, and an under-damped spring wobbles it home.

name: magnetic-grid
title: Magnetic Grid
description: A lattice of dots that feel the pointer's field — sliding, swelling and settling like iron filings.
